romania-2014.notes: Source 1: whole-host crawl of acm.ro; no 2014 Romania Programming Contest page in it (acm.ro/2014 is SEERC 2014, /Romania/report.htm is the 2016-2017 report). Probably belongs to other series/years (seerc-2014/2015, romania-2011, romania-2016).

sources.disagreement: The earlier reader confirmed it as the contest's web source; the 2014 pages in our copy are the SEERC (South-Eastern European regional, October 2014) site, and the Romania pages are of 2011 and 2016-2017, so nothing is about this edition.
sources.evidence: The crawl holds the 2011 Romania Programming Contest news page, a Romania report page for 2016-2017 (first stage held April to June 2016), and the SEERC 2014 and 2015 sites, but no page about the 2014 Romania Programming Contest.
